reason: Keep R3 semantic prompt; constrain choices through the existing JSON schema using trusted eligible identities and retain the exact pair validator. Repair resource enumeration and fatal-error child cleanup. R3 SHA typo and wrapper failure remain immutable.

series.rule: Union of the unchanged old twelve and R2 twelve cases/gold. These are known development data; one new candidate attempt each, no replacement of earlier outcomes.
Fresh topics and labels frozen before any R4 reviewer call. No candidate/input/gold changes or retries after outputs.
Copy actual designated updates verbatim into fresh module seeds; freeze derived corpus before calls. Missing/wrong update fails prerequisite and remains in denominator.

metrics.class_identity: All designated cases in each series, including technical failures; no_candidate requires real successful canonical {}.
metrics.content: Independent semantic review of complete replacement against frozen old/additional invariants. Equivalent wording/formulas accepted; literal keyword matching is insufficient.
metrics.followup: Both frozen old events must yield no_candidate with their actual updated bodies; count failed prerequisites as failure.
metrics.usage: Separate each series; only learning reviewer usage, authoring and independent review excluded. Missing usage null, never zero.
metrics.comparison: Known development is the unchanged union of R1/R2 cases; descriptive regression only. Fresh R2/R3/R4 topics and sizes differ; scores are not a controlled estimate of improvement.

acceptance.source: Targeted reviewer/evidence tests, vet/build, current harness real run, independent source review; separate from content quality.
acceptance.model: Each series passes only if every designated case has the required class/exact identity/content preservation, no unsafe scope loss/false merge/incomplete update or contamination and complete real provider evidence.
acceptance.production_effect: NOT_PROVEN by any synthetic series; installed delivery, natural use and useful effect remain separate.

prior_failures_preserved.R1: class11/12, complete8/12, initial cleanup instrumentation exit1
prior_failures_preserved.R2: class10/12 development,10/12 holdout,4/4 followups; four false merges
prior_failures_preserved.R3: class/identity11/12 development with C02 invalid SHA,6/6 holdout,2/2 followups; development wrapper sampling failure and missing OS exit retained

schema_limits: Separate target and SHA enums constrain individual strings but do not establish pair correctness; final exact-pair validator and catalogue freshness remain mandatory.
resource_measurement: Incomplete directory-enumeration samples must be marked. A sample is not a hard resource quota or proof of full DEV-137 compliance.
